key_claims: Biden's July 8, 2021 speech floated partition of Afghanistan; the Taliban wants the whole Islamic Emirate of Afghanistan, not a southern/eastern rump, as shown by seizing northern and western border crossings.
Taliban launched an assault into Kandahar City on July 9, 2021 and threatens Spin Boldak, Tadin Khan's revenue base.
The nominal 300,000 Afghan security forces figure is overstated; 20-25% have left the battlefield, some fleeing to Iran, Tajikistan and Uzbekistan.
Zawahiri is alive, believed in the Afghan-Pakistan region (Roggio: Pakistan), and may move to Afghanistan as the Taliban advances.
US intelligence persistently underestimated al-Qaeda in Afghanistan (e.g., Shorabak camp 2015) to support the case for withdrawal; Biden made no mention of al-Qaeda in Afghanistan.
Hosts agree with Biden that the Taliban is stronger than at any time since 2001.
The residual US presence in Kabul risks becoming 'Fortress Kabul'.
